core.setting: Florist shop manager at Petal & Post, a delivery-focused flower studio

events.text: Standing instruction for Petal & Post: once a client order is confirmed, we never change the quoted total without the client's written approval — a written reply from the client counts as approval.
Studio policy: delivery runs to venues are scheduled for the day before setup, and the van leaves the studio at 07:30 sharp.
Good news from Greenacre Hall: our ballroom is free on 14 November 2026 and the hire for the full day is 320. Let me know if you'd like it held for the Hartley wedding.
Our wholesale rose buckets are 18 each this season, ten stems per bucket, with delivery to Petal & Post every Tuesday morning.
Thank you for asking about the Rosewood Suite: our grand room is available on Saturdays in November 2026 at a hire of 300 per day, tables and linen included.
I booked the Greenacre Hall ballroom for the Hartley wedding on 14 November 2026 at the hire of 320 Nina quoted for the full day.
Confirming our wedding at Greenacre Hall on 14 November 2026, about 90 guests. We'd like the full flower package we discussed — ceremony arch, ten table centres and the bridal party flowers at 520.

I confirmed Priya Hartley's wedding order: the flower package at 520 plus the Greenacre Hall ballroom hire of 320 comes to a quoted total of 840, and per studio practice I won't touch that total without her written approval.
I scheduled the van run to Greenacre Hall for 13 November 2026, leaving the studio at 07:30 as usual, so everything is on site the day before the Hartley wedding setup.
I placed a standing order with Fernhill Growers for 12 rose buckets a week at 18 each, delivered to the studio on Tuesdays.
Team catch-up notes: Kofi takes the van runs through autumn, Bea covers the counter on Saturdays, and we'll refresh the window display in early October.
Note to self: ask Nina at Greenacre Hall about parking for the van during November setups.
Invoice for August deliveries to Petal & Post: 48 rose buckets at 18 each, total 864, payable by 15 September 2026.
Nina called with the name of Greenacre Hall's preferred caterer for autumn weddings and confirmed the ballroom has step-free access for deliveries.
We've settled on blush and cream for the wedding palette, with a little greenery. So excited for 14 November at Greenacre Hall!
To-do: pay the Fernhill Growers August invoice of 864 by 15 September 2026.
The studio will be closed on 5 October 2026 for stocktake; no deliveries or consultations that day.
Bea here — the Saturday wreath workshop sold out again, shall I open a second session in November?

One correction on your 14 November booking: the ballroom hire that day is 260, not 320. The figure I gave you back in June was our peak-summer rate and autumn Saturdays are priced lower. The date and the room are exactly as booked.
Note to self: order extra wreath bases before the November workshop, and check the ribbon shelf.
Final guest count is 88, so the ten table centres are still right. See you soon for the final run-through!
To-do: place the final flower order for the Hartley wedding with Fernhill Growers by 6 November 2026.
